project.name: straits
project.one_liner: An offline, cargo-focused logistics observability + agent war-gaming instrument: measure the LIVE flow of ships and air-freight through a chokepoint theater, then fork a simulated future — inject a blockage and watch each vessel reroute over weeks — rendered Plague-Inc-style on a zoomable globe, running entirely local on an NVIDIA GB10.
project.full_context: Skein is a 12-hour hackathon build for the Dell x NVIDIA GB10 event (Aug 22 2026). Requirement: an always-on BUSINESS agent that runs LOCALLY on the box (no cloud API). Skein reads pre-recorded cargo AIS (ships) + ADS-B (air-freight) for one chokepoint theater (e.g., Suez/Red Sea, or Singapore/Malacca), renders the live flow on a deck.gl globe, and lets you INJECT a chokepoint disruption (an Ever-Given-style Suez block). It then forks a SIMULATED future: each cargo vessel is forward-projected via searoute (reroute around the block / wait / divert to alt port) over simulated weeks, congestion blooms Plague-Inc-style, downstream ports back up, and the whole timeline is SAVED as a seeded, provenance-stamped artifact you can replay and compare. A local NVIDIA Nemotron agent (via NemoClaw/OpenClaw, sandboxed by OpenShell) is the always-on SENTINEL: it watches the flows, flags chokepoint stress, runs what-if disruptions on command, and briefs in plain language. The engine is domain-agnostic (agents + dependency network + shock cascade); the demo scenario is a maritime chokepoint, with a 30-second 'same engine, modern chip supply / Taiwan Strait' transfer beat to prove it is not a one-off. ETHOS: the simulated future is DECLARED FABULATION, not prediction — the sentinel shows interdependencies and reactions and REFUSES to claim it knows what will really happen. Business: supply-chain risk intelligence / logistics observability (buyers: cargo & trade-credit insurers, freight forwarders, commodity traders, defense/gov OSINT, port authorities); the LOCAL/offline form is the honest value — sovereign, air-gapped systemic-risk war-gaming, no cloud leakage. OFFLINE TIME CAPSULE: the only online step is a one-time CAPTURE — a PAST baseline (archived bulk) + a PRESENT live window (the actual capsule act, since free live feeds are ephemeral) — after which the sealed slice, the sim, the agent, and the render all run FOREVER OFFLINE on the box. Observed data (past+present) and simulated futures are preserved as SEPARATE, provenance-labelled classes, never conflated. Proof beat: pull the network cable on stage and it keeps running.
hard_rules: LOCAL-ONLY at demo time: the agent/model runs on the box; all data is PRE-RECORDED to a drive and replayed offline. No cloud API during the demo (hackathon rule + the product's sovereignty pitch).

OFFLINE TIME CAPSULE, justified: online only for the one-time capture; sealed slice + sim + agent + render all run offline. Do NOT call the archived historical bulk 'the capsule' — the capsule act is freezing the LIVE present window; historical is baseline. Observed vs simulated always labelled.
The simulated future is DECLARED FABULATION, never prediction. Every saved timeline carries its seed + assumptions + the blocked chokepoint; the sentinel refuses to name a single certain outcome.
CARGO-FOCUSED: filter AIS to cargo/tanker ship types; filter ADS-B to freighter operators. Passenger traffic is out of scope for the MVP.

HONEST COVERAGE: free AIS is terrestrial/coastal (line-of-sight ~20-40nm) — the theater is scoped to chokepoints/ports/coastal lanes where coverage is dense; mid-ocean gaps are dead-reckoned and LABELLED, never presented as real fixes.
The agent must take VISIBLE, AUTONOMOUS actions (query_flows, inject_shock, reroute_sim, brief, alert) — it is an AGENT, not a dashboard. If it only renders, it fails the brief.

PUSH THE BOX AND PROVE IT: a live telemetry HUD (GPU %, SoC watts of 140, unified-GB of 128, tok/s, vessels simulated) read from NVML/sparkview — nvidia-smi under-reports on GB10 UMA, do not rely on it. Targets: GPU >=90%, SoC >=120W, unified mem >=60GB, 10k+ vessels real-time.
This codebase is written by an AI loop: comments minimal and only where they inform the next iteration; test only what must survive repeated runs.
Rail is OUT of the MVP (freight rail data is private) — air + sea only; rail is a roadmap line, never faked.

project.scope_locked_aug20: PRIZE-RUN, not a body of work — optimize to WIN reliably, do not gold-plate. Theater=Suez+Bab-el-Mandeb (iconic) with US/NOAA-bulk as BREAK-GLASS so data can never sink the demo. Live-ness=hybrid (self-recorded past window + one live present window). Ships first; air (OpenSky, already verified) only if slack. Aesthetic=PS2 shaders + Plague-Inc playful. Demo CLIMAX=inject chokepoint -> reroute cascade blooms, agent narrates it live. Balance=50/50 business-armor-on-artful-core. History (Bronze Age)=ONE pitch line, NOT built. Ambition=swing for 1st on a reliable core that cannot break; exactly one big wow on top; settling for solid top-8 is acceptable.
project.aesthetic_lock: GOV/MILITARY-GRADE maritime-intelligence command console (Palantir/C2 register) — SUPERSEDES the earlier PS2/playful. Dense monospace HUD, top status bar, LEFT vessel-registry sidebar (search + type-filter chips + scrollable list), CLICK-to-inspect right detail panel (MMSI/type/flag/status/speed/course/DWT/dest/position), coordinate/zoom readout, 2D(mercator)/3D(globe) toggle. This UX is the defense-OSINT credibility layer.
